svg.title: koda agent architecture (overview)
svg.desc: Each turn is one LangGraph run. A router sends the request to answer, reader, investigator or the edit path. Read paths end without verification; the edit path runs an optional planner, a coder with write tools, and a verifier that judges a hash-snapshot diff plus the observed tool log, retrying once on failure.
svg.text: Each turn is one LangGraph run. Requests go to the narrowest path; only the edit path gets write tools, and only it is verified.

svg.text: no verify step on read paths
they get no write tools; verify gates side effects, not prose
without bwrap (macOS) the auto-approved read-only shell can write

text.tspan: answer streams to the user · chat / TUI append the turn to the session · Langfuse trace per turn, if configured
